task.description: Fix ISS-0156 (GH #475, BLOCKER): getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance mints an instance_id with no backing instance_projections row, so store.append always returns InstanceNotFound and every entity record create/update/delete is broken against a real database. Fix production code, not the tests.
acceptance_criteria: zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' output
No test assertion weakened; no error.SkipZigTest added

result.summary: ISS-0156 (GH #475, BLOCKER) resolved. Root cause: getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance created only the entity_type_instances mapping row, never the instance_projections row that store.append validates before every append (SELECT status FROM instance_projections WHERE instance_id = $1 -> StoreError.InstanceNotFound). Fix follows candidate resolution (a) and the established src/engine/instance.zig pattern: a new ensureEntityInstanceProjection() writes the projection row (status ACTIVE, empty variables/current_nodes, tenant from bpm_effective_tenant_id(), sentinel definition_id ENTITY_STREAM_DEFINITION_ID, NULL correlation_key) with ON CONFLICT (instance_id) DO NOTHING for idempotency and lazy self-repair. Migration 1137_iss0156_entity_instance_projection_backfill.sql eagerly repairs pre-existing orphaned mappings in every tenant schema; applied to bpm_dev and bpm_test, verified idempotent. getOrCreateEntityTypeInstance now takes std.mem.Allocator instead of using std.heap.page_allocator internally (CLAUDE.md allocator rule). Entity integration tests: 7/12 -> 10/12. All 5 InstanceNotFound failures eliminated; 3 blocks (Create, Update, Delete) now fully pass, and the remaining 2 progressed past the root cause to reach their real assertions, failing on two distinct defects filed as ISS-0159 (GH #480) and ISS-0160 (GH #481) and enqueued. Mutation check: disabling the ensureEntityInstanceProjection call reverts exactly to 7/12 with 5x InstanceNotFound; restoring returns to 10/12.
